definitions.full: H5441. sebok [ סְבֹךְ ] noun [masculine] id.; — construct ִבּסֲבָךְעֵֿץ Psa 74:5 in the thicket of trees ; suffix מִסֻּבְּכוֺ Jer 4:7 (abode of lion; on בְּ see Ges § 20h ; on ֻ֯ Kö ii. 1, 512 ).

occurrences.englishText: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.
